outcome: gastric emptying (gastric antrum cross-sectional area, gastric emptying time)
cohort: The study included 70 full-term parturient women, divided into an epidural analgesia group (n=35) and a non-epidural analgesia group (n=35).
finding: Epidural analgesia significantly facilitates gastric emptying during labour, as evidenced by smaller gastric antrum cross-sectional areas and shorter gastric emptying times compared to women without epidural analgesia.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at baseline (T0) and at 60 min (T1), 90 min (T2), and 120 min (T3) after consuming millet porridge during labour.
